## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #225 at **cb5744c2757802f7984e6733f75731a9d7fc2ab1**, under C33/C34. Reviewed the nine-file delta and directly relevant sink/identity paths. No security vulnerability identified.

| Boundary | Source evidence |
|---|---|
| Held sink identity | `crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:1273-1327` stats the current path and, before a nonempty read, reopens on either device or inode mismatch. Metadata/open errors propagate; they do not fall back to reading the old descriptor. A removed path therefore refuses until recreated. |
| Offsets and access | Equal/shrunken lengths return no bytes; shrink moves the offset to the new end, preserving prior semantics. Later growth rechecks identity. The held descriptor is read-only; trimming separately opens the current path (`lib.rs:45-51`). |
| Pane-query parity | `crates/store/src/registry.rs:435-460` binds exact pane equality, retains live and retired rows, distinguishes absent/empty and preserves ID ordering. The fake applies equivalent equality over its ordered map (`crates/testkit/src/fakes.rs:153-183`). |
| Caller selection | `crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:1250-1352` retains live-owner/dead-process/retired-history ordering and contradictory-ID refusals. An unmatched pane does not fall back to asserted identity. The optimization does not turn history explanation into authentication. |
| Registration roster scope | Only the first snapshot is Copilot-filtered; both consumers already require that harness (`registration.rs:531-580`). The locked reread remains whole-roster (`738-756`), and ID minting sees all roster IDs (`818-820`). |

The tap assertions cover held-open reads after permission removal without replay, truncation, and inode replacement yielding exactly the expected post-offset data (`crates/tmux/tests/adapter.rs:1592-1725`). The shared registry contract covers retired rows, exact empty-pane matching and exclusion of a neighboring pane ID (`crates/testkit/src/contract.rs:134-169`).

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in scoped changes under C33 | - |

**Notes/proof ceiling:** stat/open/read is not one atomic operation against a concurrent replacement; no malicious same-user race guarantee is claimed under C33. Dedicated removal/recreation and metadata/reopen-error execution was not independently evidenced here; those branches were source-reviewed. No exhaustive rotation or live caller-incarnation guarantee is inferred from individual fixtures.

**Deployment performance proof remains owed to the performance owner:** the two live hot paths, CPU, ping spawns and spawn-rate need the post-deploy sample described in the packet. This security verdict neither performs that measurement nor requires it before merge.

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN and successful current checks. Run [42776326266](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42776326266) checked merge `cbf904e5ac649d7b55afe4feafbaed04bba447ba`, whose parents are main `a1a5552c4359ec7aafd0380e86d7ebb1ef1fb06a` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,428 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful artifact `13744461235` includes the held-open/replaced/unchanged sink cases and both fake and SQLite registry contract tests as passed.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, real sink/process/pane probes, performance measurements, config/credential reads or product mutations.
